name: Power Word Heal

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A creature you can see regains all its Hit Points and is freed of Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned and Stunned.
text: The target regains all its Hit Points and those five conditions end on it. If it is Prone, it can use its Reaction to stand up.
